maintenance_led.reason: Revenue mainly from leasing railcars and building new railcars; maintenance is a smaller part.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private railroads, shippers and commodity companies leasing or buying railcars, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by investing in its own lease fleet and manufacturing, not by a steady stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Leased railcars are embedded in shippers' supply chains under multi-year leases; switching means fleet changes, qualification and downtime.

notes: Leasing is judged the larger part; railcar manufacturing is also significant.
